VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to satisfy the acceptance criteria. While the agent claims all 96 tests pass locally, there is no independent verification (CI logs, test results, diffs, or other artifacts) to corroborate this claim. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 96 tests pass," which demands objective evidence beyond self-attestation. Additionally, without seeing the actual code changes (diff), it's impossible to verify that the fix correctly addresses the root cause (switching from local clock to server-issued timestamp) or that it doesn't introduce new issues.
